Idea title: PoraBondhu AI: An AI Reading Diagnostician for Early-Grade Bangla Reading
Assessment: Grapheme-level Bangla reading diagnosis using LM-free CTC so children's errors are kept, with a Whisper baseline and teacher-in-the-loop; strongest technical depth and clear national evidence (NSA 2022). Risk: annotated child-speech data in a short build.

Idea title: SkinAI Bangladesh
Assessment: Offline Bangla skin triage for community clinics with own BD-trained model, warning-sign rules, abstain-when-unsure and Upazila doctor confirmation; very well-grounded workflow. Reuses an earlier model, which must be disclosed.

Idea title: AdhikarAI (অধিকারAI): Bangla Voice Assistant for Government Services and Citizens' Rights
Assessment: Voice-first Bangla + dialect normalisation + cited RAG over official land/GD/allowance/labour documents with honest 333 fallback; high social value, AI is the core.

Idea title: Mobile Money Scam Shield
Assessment: Checks the payment itself (fake bKash screenshots, pre-transfer scam scripts) plus a scam-trainer role-play; precise, honest, Bangla/Banglish, realistic day-by-day plan.

Idea title: Prohori: An Agentic AI Sentinel for Autonomous Vulnerability Exposure Analysis and Bounded Remediation
Assessment: Agentic vulnerability-exposure analyst: osquery daemons, OSV/CISA KEV matching on exact distro builds, AI reasoning and bounded, approved remediation. Highly original; scope is ambitious for the hackathon window.

Idea title: Ek Call: A Bangla Voice AI Agent that Explains Government Services over a Simple Phone Call
Assessment: Missed-call Bangla voice agent for government services with fine-tuned BanglaBERT, agentic RAG and verifier, SMS checklist; excellent accessibility focus.

Idea title: SnakeSafe BD: AI snakebite response that connects families and hospitals in rural Bangladesh
Assessment: Snakebite response: species/risk ID, Bangla voice triage, routing to hospitals with antivenom and pre-alert; life-saving and original.

Selected for: Govt. Teachers' Training College, Feni slot
Idea title: MyLaws: Plain-Language Legal Assistant & Formal Complaint Drafter
Assessment: Banglish legal triage grounded in 1,046 gazette sections with a deterministic citation validator and Bangla A4 PDF drafting of GD/labour/consumer complaints; live app already exists.

Idea title: OshudhGuard AI: Multimodal BD Prescription Decoder, Blister-Strip Verifier & Bangla Voice Medication Safety Assistant
Assessment: Prescription decoder constrained to 35k DGDA brands, blister-strip verification and duplicate/DDI audit with Bangla voice; very strong local relevance, ambitious multi-model scope.

Idea title: DengueSathi: AI-Powered Bangla Voice Assistant for Home Monitoring of Dengue Patients and Early Hospital Referral
Assessment: Dengue home-monitoring: Bangla voice check-ins, CBC photo reader, WHO warning-sign rules and area dashboard; timely, life-saving, well grounded.

Idea title: Kotha
Assessment: Dialect speech to standard Bangla clinical notes with red-flag rules for rural patients; original and impactful.

Idea title: Ek Oshudh, Dui Naam (এক ওষুধ, দুই নাম): Agentic AI + Medicine Knowledge Graph for the family medicine bag
Assessment: Photographs a family's medicine bag and finds the same generic under different brands, overdoses and wasted money via a medicine knowledge graph; clear, safe and impactful.

Idea title: OushudhCheck: Multi-Strip Medicine Safety Scanner & Bangla Voice Assistant
Assessment: Multi-strip medicine scanner: fine-tuned YOLO + OCR matched to 21k BD brands for duplicate/interaction alerts, Bangla voice; strong technical depth.

Idea title: AuraSign
Assessment: Two-way Bangla Sign Language translator on a plain webcam (MediaPipe landmarks + classifier, speech-to-sign avatar) for clinics; strong accessibility case. BdSL vocabulary coverage is the main risk.

Idea title: Roza-Safe: safer Ramadan fasting for people with diabetes
Assessment: Ramadan fasting copilot for diabetics: IDF-DAR risk score as rules, iftar plate photo to glycaemic-load curve, pre-iftar safety check; very local and safety-conscious (solo team).

Idea title: মাতৃকণ্ঠ Bangla Voice-based Maternal Risk Screener
Assessment: Bangla voice maternal danger-sign screener for health workers with explainable WHO/DGHS rules and referral SMS; focused and impactful.

Idea title: SafetyProof AI: Cross-Checking Factory Safety Reports Against Their Own Evidence
Assessment: Cross-checks garment factory safety records against each other with cited statuses; original and well scoped.

Idea title: FairPrice BD: Explainable Food Price Anomaly Detection and Supply-Chain Intelligence for Bangladesh
Assessment: Explainable food-price anomaly detection (forecast + uncertainty + residual anomalies + SHAP, leakage-safe evaluation); rigorous ML, depends on aligned public data being available.

Idea title: AgroLeaf AI — AI-Powered Rice Leaf Disease Screening for Bangladeshi Farmers
Assessment: Rice-leaf disease screening with own model trained from scratch, calibrated confidence with an 'I am not sure' option, Bangla cards with no pesticide doses; careful and responsible. Template placeholders were left unfilled.

Idea title: RakshA (রক্ষা) A safety app for women and children that helps before, during, and after a dangerous situation
Assessment: Women's safety app with news-based risk map, passive sound/motion danger detection and biometric confirmation; ambitious.

Idea title: ScamShield BD: বাংলা ভাষায় AI-চালিত অনলাইন প্রতারণা শনাক্তকারী সিস্টেম
Assessment: Multi-layer Bangla scam detector (rules + template similarity + community reports + LLM) for messages, links and screenshots; solid and feasible, overlaps with other scam entries (solo team).

Idea title: CircularShield: AI-Powered Recruitment Fraud Detection and Verification Platform
Assessment: Fake job-circular detection with OCR, fine-tuned BanglaBERT, rule engine and verified-organisation lookup, explained in Bangla; relevant to students, dataset is the main risk.

Idea title: Harbor: Family Care Manager
Assessment: Household meal and medicine planner with rule-checked drug-food safety for chronic patients; thoughtful design.

Idea title: BanglaShield AI
Assessment: Bangla scam guidance that asks what the user already did and routes to verified official help, with reviewed patterns; careful design.

Selected for: Gopalganj Science and Technology University slot
Idea title: PakkaDeal: AI-Powered Delivery-Charge Escrow for Safer Cash-on-Delivery Shopping in Bangladesh
Assessment: Delivery-charge escrow for COD f-commerce with buyer/seller risk scores and dispute photo checks; original local fintech.

Idea title: MaternaCare AI - An Intelligent Maternal & Newborn Care Coordination Network
Assessment: Closed-loop maternal/newborn referral tracking with voice intake and clinician-approved rules; important gap, good safety design.

Idea title: Dokan AI
Assessment: Turns messy Facebook seller captions into a structured catalogue and builds budget-safe outfit bundles with a deterministic solver; good separation of LLM vs logic.

Idea title: Capzoryx Copilot: multilingual AI that spots a small business's cash crunch early and helps fix it
Assessment: Cash-crunch radar and rescue plan for small businesses from photo/voice records, true loan cost and hash-sealed cash-flow passport; strong.

Idea title: FosholLens: Bangla Voice and Weather-Aware Crop Advisory for Rice and Potato
Assessment: Leaf disease + 48-hour weather spray window + BARI/BRRI RAG + Bangla audio; well-integrated and feasible.

Idea title: Satellite and Weather-Based Crop Outcome Predictor for Bangladeshi Districts
Assessment: District crop yield/risk outlook from Sentinel-2 NDVI, weather and soil with Bangla explanations; real ML, solo team.

Idea title: FloodSathi AI
Assessment: Bangla/English flood-report triage: embedding-based category/urgency, duplicate detection and coordinator map with human verification; focused and feasible.

Idea title: An AI-Powered Connected Healthcare Platform
Assessment: Already-built multi-portal health platform (64 checks passing) adding a Claude chatbot, OCR and reminders; strong execution, less novel as an idea.

Idea title: Real-Time AI Speech & Text Translator for Regional & Ethnic Languages of Bangladesh
Assessment: Translation for Bangladesh's ethnic languages with NLLB fine-tuning and community verification; valuable but data makes it hard to deliver.

Idea title: DocMate AI: A Personal AI Assistant for Doctors Guiding Accurate Treatment and the Right Medicine
Assessment: Closed-library RAG clinical assistant for doctors with claim verification and rule-based drug-safety checks; well thought through, but high-risk clinical scope and a heavy data burden.

Idea title: KrishiRokkha AI: Multimodal Crop Disease Triage, Bangla Advisory & Micro-Climate Outbreak Predictor
Assessment: Crop disease vision + BARI/BRRI RAG + weather outbreak risk; solid but common; template fields left blank.

Idea title: CampusFix: AI-Powered Campus Issue Reporting and Tracking
Assessment: Campus issue reporting with vision-LLM categorisation, embedding de-duplication and priority scoring; tight 5-hour plan, narrower impact.

Idea title: PlateWise
Assessment: Pre-meal calorie decision support from photos and menus; useful, less locally specific.

Selected for: Jamalpur Science and Technology University (JSTU) slot
Idea title: MonojogAI: Predictive Adaptive Focus Engine for Smart Study and Digital Wellbeing
Assessment: Phone-distraction detection and adaptive study scheduling (RF/XGBoost on usage metadata) with parent alerts; relevant to students, but the team plans an interface-only build without AI in the 5-hour final. Added manually by organisers (JSTU).

Idea title: Classmate: An Offline AI Teaching Assistant for limited-resources classrooms
Assessment: Offline classroom AI device in three hardware tiers; interesting vision but thin plan and hardware feasibility risk.

Idea title: THE LAST MILE — A platform for unfinished problems
Assessment: Platform for handing over unfinished projects; the proposal states that no AI is used in the product.
